name: Ray Field
description: Trace rays from the scene's sources, for display and for the Billiard: each ray as a polyline over its wall hits, with the scattered rays when scattering is on.

inputParameters.name: max_order
inputParameters.description: Highest reflection order traced per ray (default 10).

inputParameters.name: direction
inputParameters.description: Axis of a spotlight cone to emit the rays into, apex at each source. Empty (default): all directions. Needs angle.

inputParameters.name: angle
inputParameters.description: Half angle of the spotlight cone in degrees. Empty (default): all directions. Needs direction.

inputParameters.name: scattering
inputParameters.description: Also trace scattered rays at the reflections (default False).

inputParameters.name: seed
inputParameters.description: Seed of the scattered rays' random directions. Empty (default): a new seed each run, shown in the message. Only scattering uses it.

inputParameters.name: order
inputParameters.description: Draw only the first reflections of each ray. Empty (default): all traced orders. The ray_field output stays whole.

outputParameters.name: ray_field
outputParameters.description: The RayField, whole, for the Billiard.

outputParameters.name: rays
outputParameters.description: The rays as polylines from the source over the wall hits, up to order.

outputParameters.name: scattered
outputParameters.description: The scattered rays as polylines; empty without scattering.
